title: Vantia Artifact Envelope
description: Universal envelope for every Vantia pipeline artifact (task 1.1, R24). The emitted keys are exactly engine.llm.client.ENVELOPE_FIELDS and this schema is validated against real runtime envelopes in tests/test_schemas.py. The artifact body lives in `payload` and is validated separately against its own artifact schema (ats_score, sop, research_proposal, cv_improvement, cover_letter).

task_id.description: Vantia task id that produced this artifact (e.g. '2.7').

run_id.description: Vantia run number (integer) or run token (string) that produced this artifact.

prompt_version.description: Prompt template version that produced the payload (e.g. '1.0.0').

temperature.description: Sampling temperature used for the call (Vantia pins 0.0).

dry_run.description: True when VANTIA_DRY_RUN short-circuited the call (R25).

idempotency_key.description: Key that makes re-running the same task a no-op (R5).

prev_hash.description: envelope_hash of the previous record in the run chain (null for the first).

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical_json(payload) — identifies the artifact body.

envelope_hash.description: SHA-256 over every other envelope field — tamper-evident.

payload.description: Artifact body. Validated against the artifact-specific schema.
